title: Democracias imperfectas
goal: Read a closing assessment of these new democracies -- periodic clean elections as the sole undisputed source of legitimacy, presidents governing as if the vote gave them an unlimited mandate, persistent inequality, and limited institutional trust.

items: State what became the only undisputed source of political legitimacy.
Explain how presidents governed as if their vote gave them an unlimited mandate.
List the persistent problems many of these democracies carried.
Describe the movements (EZLN, CONAIE, Bolivian coca growers) that redefined national politics.
Use a fin de cuentas to draw a general conclusion.
